resource.energy.name: Energy
resource.energy.desc: Blue charge from civilian microreactors. Spent on buildings.
resource.residents.name: Heroes
resource.residents.desc: Your heroes on shift. Each one digs and fights.
resource.squad_cap.name: Squad slots
building.command.desc: The heart of the base. Residents come out of it. If it falls, the shift is lost.
building.home.desc: Triple bunks and a shower rota. Prints heroes up to level 2 and adds a hero slot.
building.reactor.desc: A civilian reactor running on cobalt plasma. Makes Energy while a resident operator works inside.
building.cooler.desc: Tanks and pipes of coolant. Neighboring microreactors work twice as fast. Two stations don't stack.
building.school.desc: Trains defenders from free residents by itself and expands the base territory.
building.medcenter.desc: A HeroOut medical center. Heals defenders nearby.
unit.resident.name: Hero
unit.resident.desc: A stand-in hero printed from a HeroOut backup. Digs, builds and fights, and takes parts from the enemies it beats.
unit.defender.name: Defender
unit.defender.desc: A resident after rescue school. Guards the base, attacks where you point and takes parts from defeated enemies.
enemy.adaptant.name: Adaptant
enemy.adaptant.desc: A citizen infected with Splice gel. Grew someone else's body part and can't stop.
enemy.adaptant_thermo.name: Thermo adaptant
enemy.adaptant_cryo.name: Cryo adaptant
enemy.adaptant_volt.name: Volt adaptant
enemy.heavy_adaptant.name: Heavy adaptant
enemy.heavy_adaptant.desc: A former construction-rig operator with ceramic armor and piston legs. Hits rarely, but very hard.
enemy.demon.name: Demon
enemy.demon.desc: HeroOut's underground rescuer, one of the heroes gone mad. Leads people down "to safety". Four arms, a drill tail, the heat of geothermal pipes.
site.nest.name: Adaptant nest
site.nest.desc: Splice Medium rebuilt people here. Open it and adaptants march on the base. A destroyed nest gives Energy.
site.heavy_nest.name: Heavy adaptant nest
site.heavy_nest.desc: An underground car park where a heavy adaptant holed up. Just one, slow and very tough. While the nest stands, a new one replaces the fallen.
site.demon_hatch.name: Undersun hatch
site.demon_hatch.desc: A service hatch of the geothermal station. Warmth and a steady mechanical hum below. The Demon sleeps there.
site.cache.name: HeroOut cache
site.cache.desc: A rescue-service case with spare Energy.
site.survivor.name: Survivor
site.survivor.desc: A citizen who waited out the catastrophe in a basement. Joins the base at once.
terrain.water.name: Bay
terrain.rubble.name: Rubble
terrain.rubble.desc: A fallen monorail and concrete. Slow to clear, but it gives Energy.
terrain.energy_vein.name: Energy vein
terrain.energy_vein.desc: Scattered spent microreactor cells. Residents mine Energy from it until it runs dry.
terrain.ground.name: Ground
terrain.ground.desc: Cleared ground. You can build here.
mode.call.name: Emergency Call
tech.cycle: Volt beats Cryogel, Cryogel beats Thermo, Thermo beats Toxin, Toxin beats Impact, Impact beats Volt.
tech.thermo.desc: Overheating, steam, thermo modules. Sets targets on fire. Strongest against Toxin.
tech.cryo.desc: Water and ice: cryogel tanks and cooling. Slows and freezes. Strongest against Thermo.
tech.volt.desc: Cables and electric modules. The discharge jumps to neighbors. Strongest against Cryogel.
tech.toxin.desc: Biofilters and injectors. Poisons and lowers armor. Strongest against Impact.
tech.impact.desc: Ceramics, pistons, rams. Stuns and knocks back. Strongest against Volt.
reaction.thermoshock.desc: A burning target hit with Cryogel: double damage, the burn goes out.
reaction.chain.desc: A frozen target hit with Volt: the discharge jumps to two more.
reaction.shell_break.desc: A burning target hit with Impact: no armor for 3 seconds.
reaction.burnout.desc: A poisoned target hit with Thermo: the burn is twice as strong.
reaction.neuro.desc: A poisoned target hit with Volt: stunned for a second.
enemy.standard.name: Standard
enemy.standard.desc: HeroOut's serial reserve bodies that got up on their own. They come in threes: the company saves on individuality.
ally.standard.desc: The serial line works for you now: residents appear 15% more often.
enemy.patch.name: Patch
enemy.patch.desc: A rescue dog with a mechanical paw. Brings people to their owners. Any people to any owners. Also steals Energy mid-flight.
ally.patch.desc: Good boy is home again: Energy orbs fly to the center twice as fast, and digging gives 10% more.
enemy.canopy.name: Gardener
enemy.canopy.desc: An elderly city gardener in green. Spent her life greening rooftops; now she greens everything: streets, houses, people.
ally.canopy.desc: Granny plants the right things again: Microreactors and digging give 25% more Energy.
enemy.current.name: Current
enemy.current.desc: A water rescuer. "Saves the drowning": washes people into the bay with a water cannon so there's someone to save.
ally.current.desc: Current is on our shore again: washes burns, poison and chill off residents and walks on water.
enemy.lineman.name: Lineman
enemy.lineman.desc: A high-rise rigger. Still belays everyone: ties people to poles with cable "so they don't fall".
ally.lineman.desc: Now he belays enemies, very firmly: pulls them to residents, and hits near him shock.
enemy.frostline.name: Frostline
enemy.frostline.desc: A cryogel medic. Still putting out fires: floods everything warm with gel, even microreactors.
ally.frostline.desc: Now she only puts out enemies: all enemies near her are slowed.
enemy.mason.name: Mason
enemy.mason.desc: A geotechnician. Reinforces everything: props supports across streets and walls up doors "so nothing collapses". Nobody gets out either.
ally.mason.desc: Reinforces the right things: buildings 50% tougher, rubble cleared twice as fast.
enemy.sweep.name: Sweeper
enemy.sweep.desc: A medic in a hazmat suit. Disinfects everything, residents included. Especially residents.
ally.sweep.desc: Cleans where it matters: nearby residents ignore hot ground and poison, and spare parts recycle for twice the Energy.
enemy.beacon.name: Beacon
enemy.beacon.desc: A missing-persons searcher. Finds everyone: shines a spotlight and loudly announces where everyone hides. Nests included.
ally.beacon.desc: Searches for danger now: 2 extra scanner charges, and once a minute marks a safe block.
unlock.beacon: Win without ever opening a nest by accident
enemy.hive.name: Hive
enemy.hive.desc: City monitoring by drone bees. Watches everyone and stings "rule breakers".
ally.hive.desc: The swarm watches enemies now: once a minute marks one hidden nest or lair.
enemy.kiln.name: Kiln
enemy.kiln.desc: A heavy firefighter. Still carries people out of the fire: grabs residents and hauls them off through walls. There is no fire.
ally.kiln.desc: Carries everything on his back again: residents near Kiln take 20% less damage.
enemy.seraph.name: Seraph
enemy.seraph.desc: A high-altitude rescuer and healer. Still heals: her halo drone repairs enemies around, and she flies residents off "to the hospital".
ally.seraph.desc: Heals her own now: residents near her regain health.
unlock.seraph: Win without losing a single resident
enemy.doctor.name: Doctor
enemy.doctor.desc: A neural interface specialist. "Operates" on everyone: injects enemies with gel and hands out other people's limbs.
ally.doctor.desc: Treatment as prescribed: revives a fallen resident every 90 seconds, and a new part fully heals a resident.
unlock.doctor: Give one resident every limb at once: two arms, two legs, a tail and wings
ally.demon.desc: Up here he's finally not afraid: residents dig 30% faster, and the Demon drills a block in 2 seconds.
enemy.n73.name: Seventy-Three
enemy.n73.desc: HeroOut's experimental neural circuit. Swaps bodies looking for itself. Control very much wants it back in the warehouse.
ally.n73.desc: Found which side it's on: all residents attack 20% faster, and every 30 seconds it turns an adaptant.
site.hero_lair.name: Hero Lair
site.hero_lair.desc: A HeroOut hero gone mad hides here. Open it and they come out. Leave it and they come out on their own.
site.boss_hatch.name: Call Target's Lair
site.boss_hatch.desc: The hero you were called on is holed up here. Purple numbers lead here.
